P0.title: Composite recurrence is not yet an executable hardware datapath
P0.detail: M229 has no empty-group bypass, mask/sign descriptor producer, Acc19 address/init/parent-seed/final-commit lifecycle, or physical weight/Acc SRAM wrapper. The one-cycle empty path and all-ready fixed response are external model actions. Therefore the trace arithmetic is valid under its stated contract, but F2/F4 cannot be selected or cited as physical throughput/area until one wrapper executes the same stream with explicit stalls and matched memories.

P1.title: Empty streams are outside M229
P1.detail: M229 rejects descriptor_context_mask==0 and cannot finish a header without a last descriptor. M230's 148,932 raw empty streams at one cycle require a separately specified and verified summary/bypass path.

P1.title: Ready assumptions are not frozen consistently
P1.detail: The recurrence requires continuous descriptor availability, weight_req_ready, response delivery, acc_update_ready and done_ready. The contract explicitly names request interval and response/update no-backpressure but does not state every ready edge, especially done_ready.

P1.title: Mask and descriptor production is not scheduled
P1.detail: Current/candidate scans are charged as aggregate fixed cycles, but no bounded storage or streaming schedule converts K8 pixels into ordered source/context/sign descriptors. A materialize-all interpretation omits storage; a streaming interpretation may stall descriptor_valid.

P1.title: Acc19 and parent/final lifecycle is a port cut
P1.detail: The 14,592-bit capacity, F-way read/write selection, zero/init, spatial parent seed, final 96-lane commit, group/output-block address and commit backpressure are absent. The charged final_commit count is arithmetically consistent but not tied to an interface.

P1.title: Logic-only area cannot rank physical Pareto points
P1.detail: F1/F2/F4 areas 18,219/24,013/35,715 um2 exclude all macros and fanout-scaled Acc plumbing/interconnect. The resulting 1.177x/1.055x logic TPA is diagnostic, not a physical efficiency result; no SAIF/PTPX energy exists.

P1.title: Active-chunk target is too small
P1.detail: Raw/spatial active-32 reductions are only 1.06657x/1.06706x. Even giving every skipped raw chunk one full unoverlapped cycle saves 1,797,628 cycles, under 0.36% of the raw F4 recurrence. It should not be the next primary hardware milestone.

P1.title: Distribution and population remain incomplete
P1.detail: The seal covers ten samples and ten binary FC1 modules; two stage-3 FC1 modules fall back. Per-record raw speedup min/mean/max is not summarized, and no FC2/ATLIF interaction is included.

P2.title: Same-slot full-credit turnover needs RTL coverage
P2.detail: The independent edge model confirms RTL nonblocking ordering is legal, but the production VCS receipt does not explicitly identify a tail==head full pop+push cover at L2.

P2.title: Response-order wording is narrower than RTL
P2.detail: The analyzer describes in-order fixed responses while M229 tags slots and can accept legal out-of-order responses. Freeze the modeled memory policy without implying an RTL restriction.

P2.title: Payloads are indirectly rather than directly sealed
P2.detail: M230 SHA256SUMS seals the manifest/result but not each 100-payload path as a top-level entry. The manifest transitively binds them and this review rehashed all 100, so this is packaging hygiene rather than an identity failure.

P2.title: Spatial composition needs an interface contract
P2.detail: The 2.155535x spatial result charges choice/seed cycles, but parent-output availability and seed/Acc port conflicts remain model-only. Keep it secondary until the fusion wrapper executes it.

minimum_next_milestone.name: FC1-to-ATLIF-to-FC2 two-tile elastic fusion bridge
minimum_next_milestone.why: It attacks activation materialization and the next layer's rescan, which is materially larger than the approximately 6.3% chunk-scanner-only opportunity.
requirements: Consume one finalized FC1 8-context by 96-channel block with tag/epoch/group/output-block identity.
Apply the frozen quantized ATLIF state/threshold update and emit eight 96-bit spike masks without writing a full FC1 activation tensor.
Transpose the masks into FC2 source/context descriptors and feed the existing held-weight service interface.
Use two elastic tiles so FC1 finalization and FC2 descriptor replay can overlap with explicit backpressure and empty-tile bypass.
Compare against a matched store-ATLIF-reload baseline and include mask/Acc/weight SRAM contracts.
Execute the frozen trace with FC1, ATLIF and FC2 cycle components, then run VCS and matched Synopsys DC on the bridge.
